definition_zh: 丑态；滑稽可笑的行为；低俗的插科打诨
definition_en: foolish or ridiculous behavior meant to amuse, often coarse or undignified
core_image: 小丑在台上摔跤吐舌，看客哄笑
scene: 庆功宴上他学猪叫、抢话筒，丑态百出。Everyone laughed at his drunken buffoonery.
sceneCN: 这里 buffoonery 是「丑态、滑稽行径」（第 1 个义项：逗乐而失体的可笑行为）；句意是众人被他醉酒的丑态逗笑。

pos.zh: 丑态；滑稽行为；低俗逗乐

derivatives.zh: buffoonery 的基础词，义为「丑角，滑稽可笑的人」
由 buffoon 加 -ish 构成，义为「小丑般的」

senses.title: Ridiculous clowning behavior
senses.definition: absurd or exaggerated behavior performed to make people laugh
senses.definitionCN: 为引人发笑而做出的荒唐夸张举动
senses.example: His pratfalls and pranks were pure buffoonery.
senses.exampleCN: 他摔跤恶搞的桥段全是丑角把戏。
senses.why: The -ery suffix turns the buffoon himself into his way of acting.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ery 把「丑角这个人」转成「丑角的做派」。

senses.title: Coarse low comedy
senses.definition: a theatrical style based on crude jokes and slapstick
senses.definitionCN: 以粗鄙笑料和肢体闹剧为主的表演风格
senses.example: The play mixes tender romance with broad buffoonery.
senses.exampleCN: 这出戏把柔情戏与闹剧揉在一起。
senses.why: A habit of clowning becomes a recognized comic genre.
senses.whyCN: 插科打诨积久成习，便凝定为一种低俗喜剧类型。

senses.title: Contemptible foolishness
senses.definition: behavior so absurd that it invites scorn rather than laughter
senses.definitionCN: 荒唐到招人鄙夷而非发笑的言行
senses.example: Voters grew tired of the campaign's buffoonery.
senses.exampleCN: 选民厌倦了这场竞选的丑态。
senses.why: When laughter turns cold, clowning is read as disgrace.
senses.whyCN: 笑声变冷之后，插科打诨就被读作丢人现眼，义项滑向贬责。

intro.en: Buffoonery is buffoon plus the behavior suffix -ery, following the Italian jester into English.
intro.cn: buffoonery 由 buffoon 加表行为之后缀 -ery 构成，随意大利弄臣一词一道进入英语。

items.en: buffone, the prancing jester, carried the core image of blown-up gestures.
items.cn: 意大利语 buffone（蹦跳弄臣）承载了夸张架势的核心意象。

items.en: bouffonnerie named jesting talk and clownish conduct.
items.cn: 法语 bouffonnerie 指戏谑之谈与小丑行径。

items.en: buffoonery entered English for the jests of stage fools.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪 buffoonery 进入英语，指舞台丑角的滑稽。

items.en: critics used it to condemn vulgar low comedy.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪批评家以此贬斥低俗滑稽。

items.en: buffoonery now mocks public clowning from politics to media.
items.cn: 如今 buffoonery 讥讽从政坛到媒体的种种作秀丑态。

note.en: Buffoonery belongs to the -ery family of behaviors and to the low-comedy lexicon.
note.cn: buffoonery 属 -ery 行为词族，同属低俗滑稽语汇。

entries.definitionCN: 滑稽诙谐，同用 -ery 后缀的平行词

normalIntro.en: Take the buffoon and bottle his act: that liquid is buffoonery.
normalIntro.cn: 把丑角的表演装进瓶里，那瓶东西就叫 buffoonery。

normal.en: -ery makes behavior nouns: trickery, roguery, buffoonery.
The core is still the puffing jester of Italian comedy.
normal.cn: 词核仍是意大利喜剧里鼓腮的弄臣。

normal.en: Drollery and roguery rhyme with it in structure.
Political buffoonery is the common modern collocation.
normal.cn: political buffoonery 是现代常见搭配。

normal.en: Tomfoolery is gentler; buffoonery is coarser.
normal.cn: tomfoolery 偏童趣胡闹，buffoonery 更粗俗。

abstract.en: Hear canned laughter roll over a pratfall.
abstract.cn: 听罐头笑声盖过一次摔跤。

abstract.en: See a grown man wear a lampshade as a hat.
abstract.cn: 看见一个大人把灯罩扣在头上当帽子。

abstract.en: Feel the audience's laugh cool into a sneer.
abstract.cn: 感受观众的笑声冷却成冷笑。

examples.en: The debate descended into pure buffoonery.
examples.cn: 辩论彻底沦为一场丑态表演。

examples.en: Critics praised the film's warmth and condemned its buffoonery.
examples.cn: 评论家肯定了影片的温情，批评了它的低俗滑稽。

examples.en: Years of court buffoonery had worn out the king's patience.
examples.cn: 多年的宫廷滑稽戏磨光了国王的耐心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不疯你」——台上丑角喊「不疯你我不下台」，满场丑态只为逗乐。

root: buffoonery 由借词 buffoon（意大利语 buffone，源自 buffare「喷气」）加英语行为后缀 -ery 构成，指「丑角之行」，词形或经法语 bouffonnerie 强化，属罗曼语借词与本土后缀的合成。

sensesIntro.en: The buffoon's way of acting becomes a comic genre, and finally a term of contempt for absurd conduct.
sensesIntro.cn: 丑角的做派先凝为滑稽类型，最终成为对荒唐行径的贬语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a jester's exaggerated act bottled as a style.
core.cn: 核心意象：弄臣的夸张表演被装瓶成一种做派。

branches.cn: 深夜节目里的作秀丑态

intro.en: The suffix -ery turns a person into that person's characteristic behavior.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ery 把「某种人」转成「这种人的典型行为」。

latinIntro.en: The base word is Italian by way of French; the suffix is Old French -erie.
latinIntro.cn: 词基经法语出自意大利语，后缀为古法语 -erie。
